result.summary:
CODE-DESIGNER, WF-02 step 1, round 3: a text-only pass after both CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASSes (round 2). All 18 notes - n1-n9 (REQ-001 part) and NF1-NF9 (REQ-007 part) - are applied in one pass to docs/design/REQ-001-pixel-office.md, the only file written. The validators have NOT re-checked these edits (the header says so).

WHAT THE FILE LOOKS LIKE NOW (checked by script against ORCH's before-copy, sha e09f7631..., 2888 lines): 3025 lines (sha 49eba7c9...), 35 tables well-formed, mutants M1-M51 unique and sequential (M1-M44 identical to the passed version), the test catalog is still 145 rows with the same ids in the same order, section 10.3 (the mapping of all 14 criteria of REQ-001 and all 8 of REQ-007), section 11 (quality bar) and section 12 (decisions) are byte-identical to the passed version. Diff against the before-copy: 31 hunks, 173 lines added, 36 removed; every removed line is an in-place extension of an existing row or a stale-word fix, each named in result.changes. Not changed: any test id, module, write-set entry, docs/requirements.yaml (sha de702d19...), anything outside the design file. Existing contracts are not changed; the gaps the notes name (NF1, NF2, NF6-NF9) are filled by additions.

n1 (the medium one): PG-12d6 now has eleven cases; (9a), (9b), (10), (11) separate the three wrong readings the validator named - the next request of another session closes the row, a SessionEnd of another session closes it, a SessionEnd before the request closes it - as mutants M45, M46, M47. I ran them (probe P21, Appendix A, command and output): the rule gives the expected rows, M45 differs on (9), M46 on (10), M47 on (11), nothing else moved. NF3: the U3 recipe is run through /bin/bash from a file and cleans up $TMP after the conditions. NF4: item 14 of section 13 is closed as confirmed by ORCH, section 14 says boot.js needs the eslint block at step 6, the module graph gives model.js and office-model.js their texts.js import. NF1: the Card gets the field full (card title) and keeps label as the short canvas label.

WHERE I DID NOT TAKE A PROPOSED TEXT LITERALLY, AND WHY
- Mutant numbering: the list ends at M51, not M47 as in the ORCH ruling, because n3 asks for four more mutants (M48-M51) and ORCH said to apply all notes; the numbering is unique and no existing M-number moved.
- NF1: the validator offered a rename of Card.label to full, or saying that Card.label is the full name. Both change what an existing field means or is called; I added the field full and left label as in section 3.6, so no existing contract changes and the clash is gone. OF-10 now asserts the card title.
- n4: not the bare 'или запуском сервера' - it would read as an equal alternative; the text follows the amended criterion 6(г): next request or session end first, a server start only if neither.
- Small additions beyond the numbered notes, each named in result.changes: the validator's remark under C2 that the catalogue text of case (3) must say that the current server's start record is in the journal (otherwise (3) does not separate M41); ORCH's O1 ruling recorded in section 13 item 2; an OF-13 case for the NF7 definition; the OF-10 card-title check; P21's second command (first-load time) that I re-measured for n7.

FOR ORCH: diff against the before-copy shows the change set above; the header and Appendix C (new) map each note to its sections. The REQ-001 validator's n7 measurement is confirmed on this Mac (see n7). Nothing is left open from n1-n9 and NF1-NF9.
changes: n1 [medium] - sections 10.2 (PG-12d6), 10.6 (M45-M47), 4.2 (pointer), App. A P21. Added cases (9a), (9b), (10), (11) to PG-12d6: the next request of another session, a SessionEnd of another session and a SessionEnd before the request do not close the row ((9b): with a server start between the requests the S1 row is 'окончание не записано' with closed_by server_start, not next_prompt). n3 - section 10.6 (M48-M51). A paragraph under the table says who ran them (the REQ-001 validator on its own implementation of the protocol).
